def indent_with_char(text, n, ch):
    prefix = ch * n
    lines = text.split("\n")
    indented = map(lambda line: prefix + line, lines)
    result = "\n".join(indented)
    return result

def wrap_fixed_lines(text, width, max_lines):
    words = text.split()
    lines = []
    idx = 0
    while idx < len(words):
        line = words[idx]
        idx += 1
        while idx < len(words) and len(line) + 1 + len(words[idx]) <= width:
            line += ' ' + words[idx]
            idx += 1
        lines.append(line)
    if len(lines) > max_lines:
        kept = lines[:max_lines]
        last = kept[-1]
        room = width - 3
        if len(last) > room:
            last = last[:max(room, 0)]
        kept[-1] = last + '...'
        lines = kept
    return lines

def dates_equal(date1, date2):
    pairs = list(zip(date1, date2))
    same_length = len(date1) == len(date2)
    matches = all(a == b for a, b in pairs)
    return same_length and matches
